text.tspan: TCN TemporalBlock / causal residual | Operators & tensor flow
16->32 channels / k3,d2,p4 / right Chomp4 / eval example / read bottom to top
B=batch; inputC16 -> outputC32; L16 -> convL20 -> right cropL16.
Conv1/Conv2 parameter families are independent; shortcut has its own Conv1.
Legacy weight_norm boundary retained; no upstream model execution.
Reviewed static source + selected profile. Repeated groups are templates; shapes are not runtime observations.
E### = source span; dashed = side / shape dependencies; fork/join roles are typed in IR; no implicit sum.
Repeated colors encode operation roles. Shared weights and independent instances are recorded in semantic_ir.json.
